---
title: "Zechariah"
---

# Zechariah

::: {.book-summary}
## Book Summary Insight

Zechariah encourages God's people through visions of restoration and prophecies concerning the coming Messiah. The book teaches that God will complete His redemptive purposes.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 1

<div class="key-verse">Zechariah 1:3</div>

<div class="identifier">Return unto Me, and I will return unto you</div>

### Why This Verse

Central restoration theme

### Chapter Insight

This chapter calls the people to repentance and introduces Zechariah's night visions. The key verse emphasizes God's willingness to return to those who return to Him.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 2

<div class="key-verse">Zechariah 2:5</div>

<div class="identifier">I will be unto her a wall of fire</div>

### Why This Verse

Divine protection

### Chapter Insight

This chapter contains the vision of Jerusalem's future expansion and protection. The key verse highlights God's presence dwelling among His people.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 3

<div class="key-verse">Zechariah 3:2</div>

<div class="identifier">The LORD rebuke thee, O Satan</div>

### Why This Verse

Quoted in Jude

### Chapter Insight

This chapter presents Joshua the high priest being cleansed. The key verse reveals God's grace in removing sin and points to the coming Branch (Messiah).
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 4

<div class="key-verse">Zechariah 4:6</div>

<div class="identifier">Not by might, nor by power, but by My Spirit</div>

### Why This Verse

One of the most quoted prophetic verses

### Chapter Insight

This chapter contains the vision of the lampstand and olive trees. The key verse teaches that God's work is accomplished by His Spirit rather than human strength.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 5

<div class="key-verse">Zechariah 5:1</div>

<div class="identifier">I looked, and behold a flying roll</div>

### Why This Verse

Memorable vision

### Chapter Insight

This chapter contains visions of judgment against sin. The key verse emphasizes God's commitment to removing wickedness from among His people.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 6

<div class="key-verse">Zechariah 6:12</div>

<div class="identifier">Behold the man whose name is The BRANCH</div>

### Why This Verse

Messianic prophecy

### Chapter Insight

This chapter concludes the night visions and symbolically crowns Joshua. The key verse points to the coming Priest-King who will build God's temple.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 7

<div class="key-verse">Zechariah 7:9</div>

<div class="identifier">Execute true judgment</div>

### Why This Verse

Justice and mercy

### Chapter Insight

This chapter answers questions about fasting. The key verse emphasizes obedience, justice, and mercy over religious ritual.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 8

<div class="key-verse">Zechariah 8:23</div>

<div class="identifier">We will go with you, for we have heard God is with you</div>

### Why This Verse

Nations drawn to God

### Chapter Insight

This chapter promises Jerusalem's future blessing and restoration. The key verse reveals God's zeal for Zion and His intention to bless His people.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 9

<div class="key-verse">Zechariah 9:9</div>

<div class="identifier">Thy King cometh unto thee</div>

### Why This Verse

Triumphal entry prophecy

### Chapter Insight

This chapter foretells judgment on Israel's enemies and the coming King. The key verse describes the Messiah entering Jerusalem humbly on a donkey.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 10

<div class="key-verse">Zechariah 10:1</div>

<div class="identifier">Ask ye of the LORD rain</div>

### Why This Verse

Dependence on God

### Chapter Insight

This chapter promises God's care and restoration for His people. The key verse portrays God as the Shepherd who gathers and strengthens His flock.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 11

<div class="key-verse">Zechariah 11:12</div>

<div class="identifier">Thirty pieces of silver</div>

### Why This Verse

Messianic prophecy

### Chapter Insight

This chapter depicts the rejection of the Good Shepherd. The key verse prophetically foreshadows the betrayal of the Messiah for thirty pieces of silver.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 12

<div class="key-verse">Zechariah 12:10</div>

<div class="identifier">They shall look upon Me whom they have pierced</div>

### Why This Verse

Major messianic prophecy

### Chapter Insight

This chapter foretells Jerusalem's future deliverance. The key verse points to a time when people will look upon the One they pierced and mourn.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 13

<div class="key-verse">Zechariah 13:1</div>

<div class="identifier">A fountain opened for sin and uncleanness</div>

### Why This Verse

Redemption imagery

### Chapter Insight

This chapter promises cleansing from sin and refining of God's people. The key verse foretells the striking of the Shepherd and the scattering of the sheep.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 14

<div class="key-verse">Zechariah 14:9</div>

<div class="identifier">The LORD shall be King over all the earth</div>

### Why This Verse

Climactic kingdom promise

### Chapter Insight

This chapter describes the Day of the Lord and God's final reign. The key verse declares that the Lord will be King over all the earth.
:::
